doc.description:
Transparent bidirectional bridge between USB CDC and a hardware UART. It allows a host application, such as u-center, to configure or monitor an installed serial device directly through the flight controller.
The selected UART and usb_serial must not be used by another module. The tunnel baud rate must match the connected device. When replacing a GPS driver, use gps/datalink to satisfy autopilot dependencies and treat the resulting firmware as bench-only.

configure.name: TUNNEL_PORT
configure.description: Hardware UART exposed through USB CDC; must be exclusively owned by this module

configure.name: TUNNEL_BAUD
configure.description: Hardware UART baud rate; must match the connected device
